name: Landis+Gyr E850 grid meter

specifications.basis: Landis+Gyr E850 product page (© Landis+Gyr 2026), read directly: 'Accuracy class 0.2S / 0.5S for active energy and 0.5S / 1 for reactive energy'. (value: 0.2S / 0.5S (active), 0.5S / 1 (reactive))

specifications.unit: % load (stated as 'lowest load of 2% in a single phase operation')
specifications.basis: Landis+Gyr E850 product page (© Landis+Gyr 2026), read directly: 'the precision is guaranteed even at the lowest load of 2% in a singe phase operation, unbalanced or cos φ below 1'.
Landis+Gyr E850 product page (© Landis+Gyr 2026), read directly: 'track record of successful deployments across 70 countries worldwide'.
Accuracy class 0.2S / 0.5S for active energy and 0.5S / 1 for reactive energy
Product page feature list: 50/60Hz and 16 2/3 Hz (for railway infrastructure)
8-digit liquid crystal display (LCD) for local reading of data
Exchangeable communication modules (RS 232 / RS 485 / Ethernet / GSM / GRPS / UMTS (3G)); integrated optical interface and RS485 with DLMS
specifications.value: RS 232 / RS 485 / Ethernet / GSM / GRPS / UMTS (3G)

specifications.basis: Up to 8 transmitting contacts (for energy flow, load supervision (Pmax, Qmax), capture period)
Accurately records short capture periods (as low as 1-5 minutes)
Maintains accuracy even at very low loads (2%) and under unbalanced or low power factor (cos phi < 1) conditions
The E850 grid meter is available in two main versions
specifications.value: E850 f6 wall mounted; E850 f9 rack mounted

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep. Full-parameter pass 2026-11-26: 10 new printed parameters.
